Next Generation Science (NGScience.com) is transforming primary science education from kindergarten to grade 6 by bridging the gap between traditional and modern learning methods.

NGScience surpasses other textbook and digital resources by offering complete coverage of all scientific topics and skills at each primary science grade level. This extensive range ensures that it’s adaptable to various science curriculums across the globe, making it an essential and universally relevant tool for primary science education.

NGScience’s digital platform features thousands of narrated textbook-style pages that bring lessons to life, seamlessly linked to an extensive variety of printable worksheets, quizzes, and hundreds of engaging videos. This well-integrated approach provides a comprehensive learning experience that not only enhances understanding and skillsets but also instills confidence and independence in learners.
